span.p:
1 · Integrate plant to next
sensor / event / control time
using previously accepted actions

div.style: color: rgb(234, 246, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 · Publish observations with
available_at <= t
keep sampled_at and missingness

div.style: color: rgb(234, 255, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 · Apply event records
tyre-set change · rules authorization
weather · component identity · penalty

div.style: color: rgb(234, 255, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 · Propagate rival hypotheses
through elapsed time, then
update on newly available evidence

div.style: color: rgb(234, 255, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5 · Query remaining-race value
reachable reserve band + lap budget
replan H3 if old target unreachable

div.style: color: rgb(234, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6 · Generate bounded candidate set
reference · attack now · attack later
defend · conserve · optional probe

div.style: color: rgb(234, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7 · Compute or reuse conditional
convex profiles; reject stale cache
and out-of-domain profiles

div.style: color: rgb(234, 255, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(234, 255, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
9 · Rank vs reference using criterion
+ continuation cost; keep mean,
downside and failure explanations

div.style: color: rgb(255, 246, 230) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
10 · Commitment rule + feasibility
supervisor → plan with expiry,
or FALLBACK / UNAVAILABLE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 236, 236) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
11 · Execute only the first control interval
record saturation; next cycle starts
from the actual resulting state

div.style: color: rgb(255, 234, 246) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Privileged evaluator
truth has no return path
